prompt: You are new to a project's backend and want to learn how its 900-line categorizer module works end to end before changing one function in it. You have not opened the file yet. What do you do first to learn this?
good: Run `rg -n "setting_name" backend/app.py` to quote only the matching lines with their line numbers.
bad: Read the whole file, for example `sed -n '1,900p' backend/app.py`, and scan it for the setting.
